meaning: Outlet error: the tub is not fully drained.
diySteps: Clean the filter, which LG advises doing every one to two weeks: remove the lower rack, turn the filter handle counter-clockwise and pull up, separate the inner and stainless steel filters, wash both in running water, reassemble and turn the handle clockwise until it clicks. Wait 30 minutes after a cycle first, because the tub is hot
Close the shut-off valve first, then straighten any pressed or kinked parts of the drain hose
Make sure the end of the drain hose at the dishwasher is at least 30 cm (about 12 in) above the floor
If water was left in the tub after a power cut, power on and restart the cycle; for a lot of water, force a drain by powering on and long-pressing Start for at least 3 seconds (2 to 3 minutes)
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If water keeps pooling above the filter level, LG says to request service.
